resources.string: Is message mein personal ya nuksan dene wali baat hai, isliye bheja nahi ja sakta.
Aap ki baat sun li gayi hai. Agar aap abhi khatre mein hain to kisi se fori madad lein.

Khul Ke Bolo aap ki privacy ka poora khayal rakhta hai. Chat mein aap ka naam, phone number, email ya tasveer kisi ko nahi dikhti — sirf ek random Dost nickname dikhaya jata hai. Tamam messages session khatam hone par delete kar diye jaate hain (aur zyada se zyada 1 ghante mein khud delete ho jaate hain). Sirf aap ki umar ki tasdeeq (18+) aur qawaneen manzoori ka waqt mehfooz kiya jata hai.

Privacy Notice (Placeholder — edit before release): Khul Ke Bolo never displays your real name, email, or phone number to chat partners. Peer chats use random Dost nicknames only. Messages are deleted when a session ends and carry a 1-hour TTL. Mood feedback and crisis helpline logs are stored anonymously without user IDs. You can permanently delete all your data at any time from Settings.
Khul Ke Bolo ek mehfooz, anonymous peer-listening space hai jahan log bina kisi judge kiye jaane apni baat keh sakte hain.
